explication: NiceGUI is a Python framework for building browser-based interfaces, with an optional native-window mode. The principal workflow is that a Python application declares pages and UI elements; the runtime serves a rendered client, then routes browser interactions back to Python event handlers. The README also describes binding and refreshable functions, timers, persistence, custom routes, and a broad set of higher-level visualization and interaction elements, which are shown as distinct capabilities. The source excerpts support key client, element, storage, and native-event responsibilities; wiring for unsampled subsystems is kept conservative.
